note: Both sets mix solid legend/spec extractions with vague dimension bindings, but Set A captures more verifiable facts correctly (e.g., Potable Water Reel spec 22 05 29.01, MS = MODULE SPLIT FITTING, 1" CPVC, fixture 3/4" supply and 2" waste/vent sizes) with fewer invented relationships. Set B repeats several unsupported bindings of bare '8 FT'/'30 FT'/'4 FT' dimensions to pipes and modules, misreads '60-0 FT HORIZONTAL' as a flex-pipe length, and invents MAC connections to VENT and LAUNDRY plus a fabricated '3/4" D BATHROOM GROUP' quote. Set A is not clean either — its 'header' 8 FT, 25 FT layout, Laundry-to-Shower 4 FT, GDP-to-Dishwasher and Toilet 2" waste claims are unsupported or misbound — but its errors are fewer and it covers the key spec numbers and diameters better.
